_doc: Paladin skill definitions (spec #308, one region per ticket): P4 #312 appends rush_paladin, P5 #313 blast and monster_magnet_paladin, P6 #314 charged_blow, P7 #315 and P8 #316 the four Charges and heavens_hammer. Power Strike and Slash Blast are defined by skills/hero.json and are never repeated here (a duplicate key across files is a load error, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Until a key is defined here it is inert: never offered or learned.

rush_paladin.name: Rush
rush_paladin.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and shoving every monster in your path. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Rush key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and knocking back the monsters in your path. Hold the key to keep charging.

rush_paladin._rush: tier C #312: a copy of rush_hero (H6 #302), the same definition on Paladin's book. Tier A: WZ 1221007 (P1 #309 checked every level row equals 1121006's): rank 1 = WZ level 4 at Lv1, rank 8 = level 30 from Lv16 by the shared balance.mobility_rank_levels rule; damage 78% to 130%, mobCount 15, box lt (-170,-50) to (-250,-50) rb (0,0), action rush2, effect/1..6 and effect0 dust, the Use sound (a UOL to Hero's). Tier C: the same cooldown, knock-back, hold-to-repeat and bot rules as Hero's (GAME_DESIGN 7.33).

blast._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1221009 (a single `damage` field, 170 to 550%, so one line and one target; the `blast` body action and its 840 ms (540 + 300 ms) timing; the 14-frame cast effect and the 3-frame hit, both keyed by the element art index 0/1/2/3/5; the five Use sounds). Tier C: 2.0 s cooldown (the balance pass owns it), weapon_reach targeting (the nearest mob in the held weapon's swing, as Power Strike), 0.84 s action hold, art index 0 (no Charge) until P7 picks the running Charge's node, the five sounds played in order by cast number (SkillBook.use_sound, no RNG), the rarity bonuses (Mastery, Booster, Final Attack). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.66. The screenshot `capture_delay` 0.72 s samples the thrust frame and the slash.
blast.name: Blast
blast.desc: A single devastating blow to the nearest monster within your weapon's reach.

text.desc: Deliver one huge blow to the nearest monster within your weapon's reach.

monster_magnet_paladin._rarity: Tier C: as Hero's Magnet (#303): Rare reach x1.2 (the `range` modifier: a range_around cast reads `range`), Epic Bigger Grab +2 targets, Unique Booster cooldown x0.75, Legendary Booster plus +2 targets (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter).
monster_magnet_paladin._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1221001 range 200 to 400 px, prop (pull chance 48 to 95 %), mobCount 6, the 18-frame effect and the Use sound (a UOL to Hero's 1121001); identical to Hero's 1121001 level by level (P1 #309). Tier C: a copy of Hero's `monster_magnet` under its own key (a skill key is unique across files): no damage, the shared `pull` block (7.35), the alert2 action (the node names none), the three-mob admission gate (`cast.min_targets`), the 0.6 s action hold, the 10 s cooldown (spec #308; Hero's own 4 s is tuned on Hero's runs by #346 and is not inherited), and the rarity bonuses. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.66. The screenshot `capture_delay` 0.35 s samples the horseshoe.
monster_magnet_paladin.name: Monster Magnet
monster_magnet_paladin.desc: Drags the monsters around you toward you.

text.desc: Drag distant monsters toward you, into reach of your other skills. Needs 3 monsters in range.

charged_blow._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1211002 (book 121) damage 162 to 250 %, prop (stun chance 32 to 90 %), time (stun seconds 2 to 4), range 130 to 150, mobCount 6, hpCon 15 to 25, the effect/{1,2,3,5} and hit/0/{1,2,3,5} art keyed by element (P1 #309: 1 ice, 2 fire, 3 lightning, 5 holy), the mob stun stars and the Use sound; rank 1 reads level 4 (38 %, 2 s). Tier C: it is a Form sub-skill (spec #308, P-3: it stuns in every element and has no freeze variant), the three-mob admission gate, the interval and first_after in each Charge's `subs` entry, the weapon's first swing stance and its 0.6 s display, and `form_sub_of` naming the four Charges. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.68.
charged_blow.name: Charged Blow
charged_blow.desc: Slams the monsters around you with the Charge's element, stunning them.

text.desc: While charged, blow away the crowd around you (needs 3 monsters in range) with the Charge's element, stunning them. Costs HP, never the last point.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to stun for {time} sec.

fire_charge._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1211003 (book 121, twin 1211004 identical in every field) damage 102 to 120 % (rank 1 reads level 4), alert4, the 15-frame effect and the Use sound (the twin's is a UOL, P1 #309). Tier C (spec #308, P-1, P-2, P-4, P-9): a Form of the `paladin_charge` group, 12 s window, 18 s cooldown, the 400 px admission, Charged Blow after 1.0 s then every 3.0 s, the fire element for every damaging cast of the owner (Rush included). Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.68.
fire_charge._rarity: Tier C: first-pass #315 bonuses named after the lineage (spec #308): Rare Mastery +0.10 Charge multiplier (`form_power`), Epic Booster cooldown x0.88, Unique Advanced Charge Charged Blow damage x1.3 (the Charge's `damage` modifier multiplies its sub-skills) and Charge duration x1.25, Legendary Advanced Charge plus damage x1.2 (sharing the Unique's id and repeat counter). Repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.68.
fire_charge.name: Fire Charge: Sword
fire_charge.desc: Coats your weapon with fire for a while: everything you swing takes that element.

text.desc: Coats your weapon with fire for a while: all your attacks, Rush included, deal fire damage and hit harder. Casts when a monster is near. Charged Blow fires while it lasts. Only one Charge runs at a time; the one the nearby monsters are weak to goes first.
